claims: Venezuela defeated the USA 3-2 on March 17, 2026.
Venezuela won their first-ever World Baseball Classic title.
The game was at loanDepot Park in Miami.
Eugenio Suárez hit the go-ahead RBI double in the top of the ninth inning.
Eugenio Suárez's ninth-inning RBI double was the game-winner.
Andres Machado was the winning pitcher.
Maikel Garcia was named the World Baseball Classic MVP.
Venezuela held off a late-inning rally from Team USA to win the title
